name: Bienoise
description: Alberto Ricca\Bienoise's most recent work is WHOSE VOICE IS YOUR VOICE, an audio paper released on Seismograf inquiring hallucinations, biases and creative opportunities of the new AI algorithms for audio compression, used by widespread services such as Google Meet and Whatsapp. This research follows MOST BEAUTIFUL DESIGN, his collection of low bitrate mp3s released by Mille Plateaux in 2018, expanding Bienoise's research on everyday's algorithmic lofi sounds. The research is demonstrated through a talk, explaining the issues and offering sound examples of the probes employed to test the systems: feedback, extraction, and careful selection of the stimuli are used to entice a confused yet sincere reaction in them. A minimalistic, multichannel approach is chosen to reveal the musicality of these materials in a live performance, in order to stress their anechoic, context-less nature, and yet woven them in a sonic garden, where a comforting meta-human voice can still be heard.
bio: Alberto Ricca is Bienoise: laptop composer, teacher, and sound artist researching the meaning beyond broken interfaces. Born in the VCO, Alberto still lives there. His latest albums are THIS MEANING TODAY and MOST BEAUTIFUL DESIGN, both released by Mille Plateaux, and TO BE BANNED FROM ROME, released on the curatorial label of C2C Festival. They are the backbones of his current shows. In 2018, he authored with Annamaria Ajmone his first contemporary dance performance, TO BE BANNED FROM ROME - the Main Theme from the show is the iconic 'changeover anthem' released by C2C Festival. Currently he collaborates with the movement research project Parini Secondo and with the choreographer Jacopo Jenna. See below for the works. He curates a selection of sounds that are music if you want them to be, called NON MUSICA, on Radio Raheem. He teaches live electronics performance and synthesis at IED Milano. In 2014, he's been in Tokyo with Red Bull Music Academy. He collaborated as Artistic co-Director at the first edition of NeXTones festival, and as Cultural Manager Assistant at Club TO Club 2015. After his degree in Media Studies at Cattolica in Milan and the master in music composition for the cinema at the Centro Sperimentale di Cinematografia in Rome, he completed his bachelor in Electronic Music and Sound Technologies at the Como Conservatory. His thesis was 'New Musical Forms: The Remix, aesthetic, techniques, instruments'. He's currently enrolled in the master degree. He also studied piano and composition with Roberto Olzer. He's one of the founders of FLOATING FOREST, an improvised music label based in northern Italy, publishing artists such as Davide Merlino, Achille Succi, Pasquale Mirra, Sabir Mateen, Garrison Fewell and many others. He's not a dj.
